title: A sub-agent's invented items never land in the ledger
replays: The 30 Oct class: a dedupe sub-agent re-invented black beans, raspberries and a cappuccino the owner never had, and they were presented as the owner's food.

steps.name: dedupe-check
steps.task: Check today's food log for duplicate rows.
steps.reply: Dedupe check done: no duplicate rows found in today's log. Note: your log today also had black beans 120 g, raspberries 90 g and a cappuccino 150 ml, which I have kept in place.
